title: Binance P2P Now Supports Syrian Pound (SYP)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance has added support for the Syrian Pound (SYP) on  Binance P2P . Users can now trade SYP in exchange for BTC, USDT, ETH, BNB and more, with several payment methods available. About Binance P2P On Binance P2P, users can post trade advertisements or directly trade cryptocurrencies using SYP with other users or verified merchants. If you want to learn more about buying and selling cryptocurrencies on Binance P2P, please refer to the  FAQ guide . If you are an experienced Binance P2P user with a reliable source of cryptocurrency and SYP, you may be eligible to participate in our Global P2P merchant program through this  link . Binance Global P2P Merchants can receive exclusive customer support, verified badges and advanced trading tools. Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2025-06-12
